Maria V: FYI I opened a small PR to clean up Optimize toolkit docs around batching + cache when quantized fallbacks kick in. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5021 :wave:

Alex J: nice. prefer two tiny snippets: (1) quick helper (js) using withFallback(), (2) an explicit profile (py) for advanced users. keep wording short. :ok_hand:

Maria V: agreed. also replace the ambiguous 'cache_scope=global' text 1 people read that as cross-tenant caching. we should say "route-scoped cache keys" and show including model_variant in the key.

Samir (docs): I'll pick up the PR. plan: swap deprecated example, add helper + profile, add note about CPU fallback latency and recommend a circuit-breaker link to Optimize -> fallbacks. will also fix two dead links in the migration guide.

Lena QA: QA note: show cacheKey returns a string and mention fallback_reason is surfaced. remind QA to run the snippet harness with a quant-fail simulation.

docs-bot: PR #5021 status: open  requested review from @Samir (docs), @Alex J. CI: lint OK :white_check_mark:, snippet-tests pending.

Alex J: I'll review wording later today. can someone add the local test command in the PR? e.g. `make docs-snippet-test SNIPPET=opt-quant-fallback`.

Maria V: will add the command as a follow-up commit. thx all :thumbsup:

Samir (docs): merging after Alex approves and snippet-tests pass.
